stem.text: Which compound could show **both** *cis-trans* isomerism and optical isomerism?

A.alt: CBr2=CHCHBrCl: displayed formula with two Br on one alkene carbon, H on the other, bonded to a CH carbon bearing Cl and Br

B.alt: CBrI=CHCHBrCl: displayed formula with Br and I on one alkene carbon, H on the other, bonded to a CH carbon bearing Cl and Br

C.alt: CBrCl=CHCOCBr2Cl: displayed formula with Br and Cl on one alkene carbon, H on the other, bonded to a C=O group then a CBr2Cl carbon

D.alt: CBr2=CHCHClI: displayed formula with two Br on one alkene carbon, H on the other, bonded to a CH carbon bearing Cl and I
